1857768.name: Bais Bezalel Chabad
1857768.note: Its About page, on the chabad.org site set up for it on May 21 2012 (the page as archived Feb 24 2013): 'In response to a call from the Lubavitcher Rebbe in 1977 to open new places of davening and learning in the spirit of Chabad Chassidus, Bais Bezalel began 35 years ago in a 2nd floor office complex on Pico Boulevard near Beverly Drive ... We then acquired the property where Bais Bezalel is now in 1996.' Written in 2012, 35 years back is 1977, the year of the Rebbe's call it names, so 1977 (counted back, medium). The same words are still on its new site (chabadpico.com/about, dated August 2022), where '35 years ago' no longer fits. Rabbi Moshe Levin; also called Chabad Pico.

earlier.where: a 600 sq ft shteibel in a 2nd-floor office complex on Pico Blvd near Beverly Drive
